prompt: Two parallel roof rafters are crossed by a diagonal strut. A pair of co-interior (same-side interior) angles measure $(2x + 10)^\circ$ and $(3x + 20)^\circ$. Find $x$.
hint: Same-side interior angles are supplementary, not congruent.

hints.text: Same-side interior angles are supplementary, not congruent.

explanation: On parallel lines, co-interior angles add to $180^\circ$.
Check: the angles are $70^\circ$ and $110^\circ$, and $70 + 110 = 180$. ✓

alternativeExplanations.title: Congruent or supplementary?
steps: Sort every parallel-line pair into one of two buckets: congruent (corresponding, alternate interior, alternate exterior) or supplementary (co-interior).
Co-interior is the supplementary bucket, so you add to 180 instead of setting equal — that choice is what makes $x = 30$ instead of something else.
